title: Jagged Yeasty French Mitsuba Canele
description: A yeasty, shattering, midnight-craving French dish featuring mitsuba, binchotan-charcoal, and a keto-friendly twist, all in the form of a delicate canele.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine almond flour, mitsuba, binchotan charcoal powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, granulated sweetener, and active dry yeast.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Melt the unsalted butter and fold it into the batter.
Pour the batter into canele molds and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Bake the caneles for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove the caneles from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the jagged yeasty French mitsuba caneles warm and enjoy.
